description: This file defines a static utility class 'StableHash' for computing hash digests from byte data or strings within the Orleans project. It includes methods that optimize hash computation and handle endianness.

classes.name: StableHash
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to compute hash digests with consideration for endianness.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes a hash digest of the input byte span efficiently, using XxHash32 and handling system endianness.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes a hash digest of the input string, considering system endianness, and converting the string to bytes appropriately.
